scope: adjudication of WP1 FINDING 1 - G07 / G08 / MID_SUPPORT positive-volume interference
verdict: ONE REAL POSITIVE-VOLUME OVERLAP EXISTS AND IT IS NATIVE-ONLY (G08). G07 AND MID CARRY NO OVERLAP IN EITHER REPRESENTATION. unexplained_positive_interference_count = 0, carried together with an explicit statement of what was NOT evaluable.
authority_chain: ODR-03: the FreeCAD/STEP neutral chain is the system-level geometry authority; the SolidWorks native line is permanently off the critical path with status NATIVE_REINTEGRATION_HOLD

No neutral stow-support geometry exists here, so only the ODR-03 half of the precedent is invoked and no equivalent positive validation is claimed.

decision rule: Authority > Evidence > Independent reproduction > Agent opinion. Voting forbidden.

escalation_assessment.conclusion: decided autonomously; all three interfaces were adjudicated on reproducible geometry evidence, so no owner escalation is required

method.geometry_access: read-only. Chunked binary-STL vertex/triangle streaming and STEP text parsing only. No boolean kernel, no CAD application.

arm_tessellation.connectivity_method: exact float32 bit-identity vertex sharing + scipy.sparse.csgraph.connected_components
arm_tessellation.precision_note: the tessellation is float32; residuals below about 1e-4 mm are storage noise, not measurements

method.overlap_test: for each arm triangle, AABB overlap against the exact axis-aligned box union of each native saddle solid. AABB overlap is a NECESSARY condition for true solid overlap, so a zero count is a conservative proof of no positive common volume; a non-zero count is then refined by a strict point-in-box interior test.

independent_reproduction_of_wp1_measurem.conclusion: WP1 did not fabricate any number. The defects are in MEASUREMENT SCOPE and in the DECLARED SOURCE VALUES, not in WP1's arithmetic.

E1_the_native_saddles_are_cradles_not_fl.method: exact vertex-plane decomposition of the three 28-triangle native saddle tessellations
E1_the_native_saddles_are_cradles_not_fl.result: each saddle is a union of axis-aligned boxes - a full-width tower plus TWO PRONGS separated by an open cradle notch exactly 3.000 mm deep
E1_the_native_saddles_are_cradles_not_fl.consequence: a single scalar 'tower top z' is not a valid counterface datum for a cradle. WP1's signed_gap_to_v1_tower_top compares the arm against the highest surface of a notched part over a footprint in which that surface covers only 8 mm of the 60 mm y-span.

E3_the_G07_0p4256_mm_figure_is_a_measure.centring_assumption: foot-centred, explicitly flagged by WP1 as NOT stated in the V2 definition
E3_the_G07_0p4256_mm_figure_is_a_measure.interpretation: 4 of the 5 vertices that generate the 0.425611 mm figure lie 4.10 to 4.62 mm OUTSIDE the part in x. Inside the real footprint the residual is 43.6 nanometres, i.e. float32 tessellation noise. The 0.4256 mm is an artifact of an unstated head-centring assumption, not a design conflict.

E4_the_G08_declared_pad_station_is_a_sin.declared_method_string: arm CAD mesh vertices over the footprint, lowest-band fit -- not a bbox pick
E4_the_G08_declared_pad_station_is_a_sin.windows_scanned_for_a_reproducing_footpr: 1425 square sub-windows of side 10 / 20 / 30 / 34 / 40 mm over the G08 region; ZERO reproduce 208.4929 within 0.002 mm
E4_the_G08_declared_pad_station_is_a_sin.which_bodies_actually_penetrate: the penetrating material belongs to the slender bodies 90 (1468 vertices, y 64.63 to 84.44 mm) and 98 (5992 vertices, x 129.16 to 425.99 mm) that run along the +Y flank of the arm, NOT to the main structural body 97, which clears the cradle notch floor by 0.247755 mm
E4_the_G08_declared_pad_station_is_a_sin.interpretation: G07 and MID satisfy the declared method exactly. G08 does not: its declared station is a single isolated vertex, 2.0 mm above the declared pad-carrier top and 1.825 mm above its own body's footprint minimum, and the declared contact band x[163.167, 172.33] y[46.643, 60.009] is drawn around exactly that vertex. The G08 counter-face search failed on its own stated method, for G08 alone.
E4_the_G08_declared_pad_station_is_a_sin.inheritance: because the V2 definition derives head_top_z, head_bottom_z, flare_bottom_z and pad_carrier_top_z from pad_face_z, the ENTIRE G08 head station stack inherits this error

E5_root_cause_of_the_recurring_envelope_.finding: the native 'arm stow support' group asset is the union of THREE HARDWARE SADDLES and TWO PURE REFERENCE BLOCKS - a launch-lock interface reference and a release-clearance envelope - with no attribute distinguishing hardware from non-hardware. Any measurement that consumes this group silently mixes them.

confirmation_of_the_prior_F3_audit_findi.verdict: CONFIRMED - the prior 3 mm reading was the envelope block, not the arm

E5_root_cause_of_the_recurring_envelope_.standing_rule_issued: never measure a stow relationship against 04_ARM_STOW_SUPPORT.stl as a whole; always use the per-part saddle tessellations

E6_the_stowed_arm_pose_itself_is_not_kin.interpretation: the global registration residual of the geometry these numbers were measured on is two to three orders of magnitude larger than the numbers themselves. Millimetre-level interference cannot be adjudicated on this representation in either direction; this is why the G08 native overlap is recorded as a native-representation fact and NOT promoted to an authority-baseline interference.

corrections_to_wp1_for_terminal_round_2.wp1_item: SUP-OPEN-G07-02 claim that the V1 relationship 'was effectively hard contact, not the 3 mm stand-off'
corrections_to_wp1_for_terminal_round_2.wp12_ruling: PARTLY INCORRECT, SAME ROOT CAUSE. The -0.003998 mm reading uses the same out-of-footprint vertex. Over the real Aft_Saddle footprint the arm clears the part by 0.990844 mm above the +Y prong, 3.421556 mm above the notch floor and 28.116333 mm above the -Y prong, with 0 triangle-AABB overlaps. ruling_rationale: there IS a real positive-volume overlap, but exclusively between two native-line objects - the native V1 Fwd_Saddle tessellation and the native stowed-arm tessellation. Depth 2.254534 mm below the cradle notch floor at 206.42 mm, 81 triangle-AABB overlaps, 60 triangles with an interior vertex, 66 unique interior vertices.

neither operand exists in the authority baseline: the V2 support is DEFINED_NOT_MODELLED in both chains (exists_in_design_freeze_assembly = false, exists_in_neutral_step = false) and the arm is an 817.651847974 mm3 frame/axis witness at q0 / ARM_TASK_READY. 0 STEP control points lie in the G08 head volume or column.
the V1 Fwd_Saddle tower is itself superseded by the V2 head per the same V2 definition, so the overlap is between a superseded part and a superseded pose.

ODR-03 places the SolidWorks native line permanently off the critical path with status NATIVE_REINTEGRATION_HOLD, and 'SolidWorks native reintegration' is an explicitly permitted non-blocking hold in the terminal release condition.
the arm pose carrying the overlap has an unresolved FK regression residual of 567.734 mm, which is 251.8 times the overlap depth.
